name: compose-pipeline
description: Demonstrates composition: this orchestration nests two existing orchestrations (refinement-loop and decision-tree) as subflows. State is shared, so any ${as} set inside a subflow is readable downstream.

phases.name: decide-what-to-build
phases.description: Run the decision-tree orchestration to triage the incoming ticket; its final output is stored as ${plan}.

phases.name: draft-the-output
phases.description: Run the refinement-loop orchestration to draft + polish based on the plan from the previous subflow. Inherits state, so the inner writer sees ${plan}.
